superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I notice a changed denominator: BVK has 0 of 24 expected slots, while Blic has 0 of 96, so their missing arrivals do not share the same reporting baseline [F11][F24]. I also see silence spanning Beograd and Košutnjak, the airport, and the river gauges at Beograd and Zemun; that does not locate a disruption in any neighborhood [F26][F27][F28].
hypotheses_sr: Zajednički problem prijema mogao bi bolje da objasni tišinu ovih geografski razdvojenih instrumenata nego lokalizovan gradski događaj; sami zapisi prijema ne mogu da potvrde to objašnjenje [F26][F27][F28].
questions_sr: Da li tišina koja obuhvata Beograd, Košutnjak, aerodrom i Zemun potiče iz prikupljanja, a ne sa instrumenata [F26][F27][F28]?
